family.description: This entry corresponds to Human SARS coronavirus (SARS-CoV) and similar betacoronaviruses NS7B protein (also known as accessory protein 7b, NS7B, ORF7b and 7b)[[cite:PUB00094107]]. It was found to be a structural component of SARS-CoV virions and an integral membrane protein. Its transmembrane domain is essential for Golgi compartment localization [[cite:PUB00094109]][[cite:PUB00094108]].
family.name: Betacoronavirus NS7B protein
